title: UR5e · coordinated tape · tool path and stick robot per situation (sim, FK)
source: pidtuna-website site/public/data (last changed at c02e786), read 2026-10-26: ur5e.json tapes[coordinated]; FK by MuJoCo 3.17.0 on ~/pidtuna/src/pidtuna/models/ur5e_bare.xml (pidtuna f93cf9c).

t.note: Seconds from the target's start; every 0.02 s (50 Hz) of the 100 Hz replay, for display only.

situation.note: target or one of pidtuna's four controller rungs (sim).

px.note: Tool site `tool` world x: MuJoCo forward kinematics of the replayed joint angles (sim), model ur5e_bare.xml. Rounded to 1 µm.

py.note: Tool site world y, as px.

pz.note: Tool site world z (up), as px.

err_mm.note: |p − p_target|: distance from this situation's tool position to the target's FK at the same t, mm (MuJoCo forward kinematics of the replayed joint angles, sim). Null on target rows. Encoder-style FK, not a camera.

s0x.note: Stick robot point 0 (base), world x: MuJoCo forward kinematics of the replayed joint angles (sim), model ur5e_bare.xml (xpos of the body origin; the last point is the tool site). Rounded to 0.1 mm.
